title: Monotonicity of e^{κs}s^{−n}I(s) on (0, r] from the differential inequality nI − sI′ ≤ κsI
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, κ, r ∈ ℝ and I, I′ : ℝ → ℝ. Assume that I is continuous on (0, r], that I has derivative I′(s) at every s ∈ (0, r), and that n·I(s) − s·I′(s) ≤ κ·s·I(s) for every s ∈ (0, r). Then s ↦ e^{κs}·s^{−n}·I(s) (in Lean: fun s => Real.exp (κ * s) / s ^ n * I s) is nondecreasing on (0, r] (MonotoneOn on Ioc 0 r); i.e. e^{κσ}σ^{−n}I(σ) ≤ e^{κρ}ρ^{−n}I(ρ) whenever 0 < σ ≤ ρ ≤ r. No sign condition on κ or on I is assumed; for r ≤ 0 the statement is vacuous.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (κ r : ℝ) (I I' : ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn I (Ioc 0 r) → (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 r, HasDerivAt I (I' s) s) → (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 r, (n : ℝ) * I s - s * I' s ≤ κ * s * I s) → MonotoneOn (fun s => Real.exp (κ * s) / s ^ n * I s) (Ioc 0 r)
